54939674.description: Difluoroescaline , also known as 4- -3,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline.

57014554.name: 3-APB
57014554.description: 3-APB, also known as 3- benzofuran or as 1-oxa-α-methyltryptamine , is a drug of the benzofuran family related to the psychedelic tryptamine α-methyltryptamine .

59474330.name: Ifupinostat
59474330.description: Ifupinostat is a drug used for the treatment of cancer.

76943386.name: Abaloparatide
76943386.description: Abaloparatide, sold under the brand name Tymlos among others, is a parathyroid hormone-related protein analogue medication used to treat osteoporosis.

82281626.name: 3-Methoxymethcathinone
82281626.description: 3-Methoxymethcathinone , also known as meta-methoxymethcathinone , is a designer drug of the substituted cathinone family described as a stimulant.

92028826.name: Strontium nitride
92028826.description: Strontium nitride, Sr3N2, is produced by burning strontium metal in air (resulting in a mixture with strontium oxide) or in nitrogen.

122666778.name: ALC-0315
122666778.description: ALC-0315 ([ azanediyl]di bis ) is a synthetic lipid.

130431386.name: SR-14968
130431386.description: SR-14968 is a drug which acts as a biased agonist at the μ-opioid receptor, selective for activation of the G-protein signalling pathway over β-arrestin 2 recruitment.

132512026.name: Fluorothiazinone
132512026.description: Fluorothiazinone is an antibiotic drug, first developed in Russia in 2010 and active against various species of Gram-negative bacteria through inhibition of the type III secretion system .

134814234.name: VUBI1
134814234.description: VUBI1 is a drug that acts as an activator of the guanine nucleotide exchange factor protein SOS1, increasing the rate at which it catalyzes the exchange of GDP for GTP on its target protein KRAS.

135565082.name: Talazoparib
135565082.description: Talazoparib, sold under the brand name Talzenna, is an anti-cancer medication used for the treatment of breast cancer and prostate cancer.

137319706.name: Orforglipron
137319706.description: Orforglipron, sold under the brand name Foundayo, is an oral, non-peptide, small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist developed as a weight loss drug by Eli Lilly and Company.

139092506.name: Gold(I,III) chloride
139092506.description: Gold chloride is the inorganic compound with the chemical formula Au4Cl8.

146464666.name: NU-1223
146464666.description: NU-1223 is an experimental drug from the β-carboline family, which is thought to act as a selective agonist of the 5-HT2C receptor.

163585306.name: BK-5-MAPB
163585306.description: βk-5-MAPB, or BK-5-MAPB, is an entactogen of the benzofuran and cathinone groups which is related to both 5-MAPB and methylone.

164875418.name: Setidegrasib
164875418.description: Setidegrasib is an investigational new drug that is being evaluated by Astellas Pharma for the treatment of solid tumors. It is an PROTACs degrader of the KRAS protein harboring a G12D mutation.

167518234.name: Atilotrelvir
167518234.description: Atilotrelvir is a drug for the treatment of COVID-19.

169776410.name: DOB-NBOMe
169776410.description: DOB-NBOMe, or NBOMe-DOB, also known as N- -4-bromo-2,5-dimethoxyamphetamine, is a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist and possible psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, DOx, and 25-NB families.

169776666.name: DOI-NBOMe
169776666.description: DOI-NBOMe, or NBOMe-DOI, also known as N- -4-iodo-2,5-dimethoxyamphetamine, is a non-hallucinogenic serotonin 5-HT2A receptor biased agonist of the phenethylamine, DOx, and 25-NB families.

172908698.name: RS130-180
172908698.description: RS130-180, also known as N- -2,5-dimethoxy-4- phenethylamine, is a β-arrestin-biased serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist of the phenethylamine, 2C, and NBOMe families.

175663130.name: Eloralintide
175663130.description: Eloralintide is an experimental drug that works as a selective amylin receptor agonist.

900000026.name: 202-CoV
900000026.description: 202-CoV is a COVID-19 vaccine candidate developed by Shanghai Zerun Biotechnology Co., Ltd., Walvax Biotech. It is one of several candidates under development by Walvax.

900000154.name: Ammonium hexabromomercurate(II)
900000154.description: Ammonium hexabromomercurate is a chemical compound with the chemical formula 4[HgBr6].

900000282.name: Bezlotoxumab
900000282.description: Bezlotoxumab, sold under the brand name Zinplava, is a human monoclonal antibody designed for the prevention of recurrence of Clostridioides difficile infections.

900000410.name: Caplacizumab
900000410.description: Caplacizumab, sold under the brand name Cablivi, is a monoclonal antibody used for the treatment of thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura.

900000538.name: DEMPDHPCA-2C-D
900000538.description: DEMPDHPCA-2C-D is a possible serotonergic psychedelic of the phenethylamine and 2C families.

900000666.name: ECTFE
900000666.description: ECTFE is an alternating copolymer of ethylene and chlorotrifluoroethylene. It is a semi-crystalline fluoropolymer , with chemical corrosion resistance properties.

900000794.name: Europium(III) telluride
900000794.description: Europium telluride is an inorganic compound, one of the tellurides of europium, with the chemical formula Eu2Te3.

900000922.name: Haemophilus B and hepatitis B vaccine
900000922.wikipedia: Haemophilus B and hepatitis B vaccine
900000922.description: Haemophilus B and hepatitis B vaccine is a combination vaccine whose generic name is Haemophilus b conjugate and hepatitis B recombinant vaccine.

900001050.name: Isopar M
900001050.description: Isopar M is a nearly clear odorless petroleum distillate and solvent produced by ExxonMobil.

900001434.name: Oprelvekin
900001434.description: Oprelvekin is recombinant interleukin eleven , a thrombopoietic growth factor that directly stimulates the proliferation of hematopoietic stem cells and megakaryocyte progenitor cells and induces...

900001562.name: Platinum diphosphide
900001562.description: Platinum diphosphide is a binary inorganic compound of platinum metal and phosphorus with the chemical formula PtP2.

900001690.name: Potassium octachlorodirhenate
900001690.description: Potassium octachlorodirhenate is an inorganic compound with the formula K2Re2Cl8.

900001818.name: Ruplizumab
900001818.description: Ruplizumab is a humanized monoclonal antibody intended for the treatment of rheumatic diseases like systemic lupus erythematosus and lupus nephritis.

900002074.name: Trihydrogen cation
900002074.description: The trihydrogen cation or protonated molecular hydrogen is a cation with formula H+3, consisting of three hydrogen nuclei sharing two electrons.

900002202.name: Zanolimumab
900002202.description: Zanolimumab is an investigational human monoclonal antibody and an immunosuppressive drug.
